description: Account Owner Reference – reference assigned to the reported transaction by the account owner
Accrued Interest Amount – amount of interest accrued in between coupon payment periods
Activity Flag – indicates whether transactions are reported in this statement (Y/N)
Account With Institution – financial institution where the relevant account is held
Additional Information Block – end-of-block marker (16S) for supplementary narrative section
Alternate Identification – alternate identification for a party (e.g. LEI code via 95L)
Account Servicer Reference – reference assigned to the transaction by the account servicer
Blockchain Address or Wallet – blockchain address or DLT wallet where digital assets are maintained
Beneficial Ownership Indicator – specifies whether there is a change of beneficial ownership
Block Trade Indicator – specifies whether the settlement instruction is a block parent or child instruction
Buyer – purchasing counterparty or their custodian in the transaction
Corporate Action Event Indicator – specifies the type of corporate action event
Cancellation Request – function code: message requests cancellation of a previously sent message
Cancellation Instruction Reference – reference number of a linked cancellation instruction
Cash Settlement System Indicator – specifies which cash settlement system is to be used
CCP Eligibility Indicator – specifies whether the transaction is eligible for central counterparty clearing
Client Collateral Instruction Reference – reference assigned to the collateral instruction by the client
Client Triparty Collateral Transaction Reference – client's reference for the triparty collateral transaction
Counterparty Market Infrastructure Transaction Identification – counterparty's transaction ID at a market infrastructure
Complete/Updates Indicator – specifies whether the statement is complete or contains changes only
Copy Duplicate – function code: message is a copy for information purposes (audit trail)
Common Reference – unique reference agreed upon by the two trade counterparties to identify the trade
Sub-safekeeping Statement – indicates whether holdings are reported at sub-safekeeping account level
Copy – function code: message is a copy to a party other than the account owner/servicer
Corporate Action Reference – account servicer's reference for a related corporate action event
Number of Days Accrued – number of days used for accrued interest calculation
Delivering Agent – custodian or institution responsible for delivering the securities
Deal Price – agreed trade price between buyer and seller (principal amount)
Duplicate – function code: message is a duplicate of a message previously sent
Expected Settlement Date – currently expected date on which settlement will be executed
Actual Settlement Date – date on which settlement was or will actually be executed
Final Closing Balance – sum of the opening balance and all entries at close of the statement period
Financial Instrument Block – end-of-block marker (16S) for the financial instrument section
First Opening Balance – opening balance for the statement period (equals prior period closing balance)
Form of Securities – specifies the physical or electronic form of the financial instrument
General Information Block – end-of-block marker (16S) for the general header section
Last Page – indicates the last page of a multi-page statement
Letter of Guarantee Indicator – specifies whether physical settlement may use a letter of guarantee
Linkages Block – end-of-block marker (16S) for the linkages section
Market Side Indicator – specifies whether an instruction is for a market side or client side transaction
Method of Interest Computation Indicator – specifies the computation method for accrued interest
Market Infrastructure Transaction Identification – transaction ID assigned by a market infrastructure
Intermediate Page – indicates an intermediate page of a multi-page statement (more pages to follow)
Movement Status – provides the current processing or settlement status of the movement
Netting Eligibility Indicator – specifies whether the settlement transaction is eligible for netting
New – function code: new message (original instruction or statement)
Only Page – indicates a single-page statement (no further pages)
Payment Indicator – specifies whether the instruction is free of payment or against payment
Processor Transaction Identification – transaction reference assigned by the processor of the instruction
Place – generic place or location identifier (e.g. place of listing or trading venue)
Pool Reference – collective reference identifying a set of related messages
Previous Message Reference – message reference of the previously sent linked message
Prepared Settlement Date – date on which settlement is initially prepared or proposed to occur
Processing Reference – reference meaningful to the identified party for processing purposes
Partial Settlement Indicator – specifies whether partial settlement is allowed for this instruction
Place of Settlement – securities depository or CSD used to settle the transaction (e.g. EUCL / CEDE)
Posting Amount – amount of money that is to be or was posted to the account
Receiving Agent – custodian or institution responsible for receiving the securities
Receive/Deliver Indicator – specifies whether the transaction is a receipt or delivery of financial instruments
General Reference – general-purpose reference number for this transaction
Registration Indicator – specifies whether registration should occur upon receipt of securities
Related Message Reference – message reference of the previously received linked message
Repurchase Type Indicator – specifies the type of repurchase transaction (e.g. REPO / RVPO)
Restrictions Indicator – restrictions governing the transfer of ownership of the financial instrument
RTGS Indicator – specifies whether settlement is to be executed via Real-Time Gross Settlement system
Safekeeping Account – account at a custodian or CSD where the securities are held
Seller – selling counterparty or their custodian in the transaction
Sender's Message Reference – reference assigned by the sender to unambiguously identify this message
Settlement Parties Block – end-of-block marker (16S) for the settlement parties section
Settlement Transaction Type Indicator – specifies the underlying type of settlement transaction
Settlement System/Method Indicator – specifies whether to use the default settlement system or method
Settlement Amount – currency and total amount to be settled for the transaction
Statement Frequency Indicator – specifies the frequency at which the statement is produced
Settlement Forward – indicates a forward or future settlement date beyond the standard cycle
Short Sale Indicator – indicates whether the sale instruction is a short sale
Stamp Duty Indicator – specifies the stamp duty type or applicable exemption reason
Statement Basis – specifies the type of balances on which the statement is prepared
Settlement Transaction Condition Indicator – specifies the conditions under which the trade was to be settled
Sub-safekeeping Account Block – end-of-block marker (16S) for sub-custodian account section
Tax Capacity Party Indicator – specifies the tax role capacity of the instructing party
Triparty Agent Collateral Transaction Reference – triparty agent's reference for the collateral transaction
Trade Date – date on which the trade was agreed between buyer and seller
Transaction Indicator – specifies the type of settlement activity to which this instruction relates
Transaction Details Block – end-of-block marker (16S) for the transaction details section
Party Capacity Indicator – specifies the capacity or role of the party in the transaction
Triparty Agent Collateral Instruction Reference – triparty agent's reference for the collateral instruction
Transaction Details Narrative – free-text additional details on the transaction (70E)
Transaction Reference – unique reference assigned by the sender to identify this instruction
